releaseNotes:
v0.9.92

Room roster
- Live list of people in the room, kept in join order
- Message someone in public chat or whisper from the list
- Remove User from the room (host action, not Kick)
- Rejoins always return to the list and Activity Log, with a visit count

Welcome and layout
- Header shows when only the second welcome message is on
- Section open/closed state is remembered more reliably

Also
- Activity Log no longer repeats old leave lines
- Greeting still greets once; the live list is no longer tied to that skip
